description: This file contains utility functions for vector operations such as creation, transformation, and analysis, used within a graphics or geometry context.

methods.name: vector
methods.description: Creates a vector from x and y coordinates, optionally offset by an origin.

methods.name: vectorFromPoint
methods.description: Converts a point to a vector relative to an origin, with optional threshold and default value.

methods.name: vectorCross
methods.description: Calculates the cross product (perpendicular scalar) of two 2D vectors.

methods.name: vectorDot
methods.description: Calculates the dot product of two vectors.

methods.name: isVector
methods.description: Checks if a value has the shape of a 2D vector.

methods.name: vectorSubtract
methods.description: Subtracts one vector from another component-wise.

methods.name: vectorScale
methods.description: Scales a vector by a scalar.

methods.name: vectorMagnitudeSq
methods.description: Calculates the squared magnitude of a vector.

methods.name: vectorMagnitude
methods.description: Calculates the magnitude (length) of a vector.

methods.name: vectorNormalize
methods.description: Normalizes a vector to unit length.

methods.name: vectorNormal
methods.description: Calculates the right-hand normal of a vector.
